subject: ida-veyra
label: The stillest woman on the land
field: Isolde Cerise Veyra · the compound superlative
from: THE WINTER KIRIN — a still hearth in human form, with no ranking attached
to: QUIETEST AND MOST RESERVED WOMAN IN THE ENTIRE COMPOUND. All three Havens.
note:
A COMPOUND-WIDE SUPERLATIVE, which is a rarer kind of fact than a trait: it holds her against eighty-three other women across Ghost, Specter and Banshee, several of whom are professionally loud. RULED BY VIRAENA.

SHE STILL HAS HER OWN THINGS. Reserved is a temperament, not an absence, and the Archive is not to write her as furniture in a room full of noise.

NOTE ON THE NAME, SO NO LATER SWEEP TRIPS ON IT: ISOLDE AND IDA ARE ONE WOMAN. Isolde Cerise Veyra, who goes by Ida, filed at id ida-veyra, 05-117, the survivor of the pair. Mikaela’s entry calls her Isolde and Ida’s own row calls her Ida, and both are correct. THE ARCHIVE CHECKED THIS BEFORE FLAGGING IT AS A DEFECT, and it was not one.
